record.content: Recreation.gov identifies Rock Creek Lake campground at 37.4538222,-118.7390139 and 9,600 feet. It describes lakeshore sites including tent-only walk-ins, nearby boat rentals, groceries and showers, on-site firewood, bear-proof lockers, electric-motor-only boating, and the Tamarack Trail beginning in the campground. Notices limit pets to two on leash and require food security.
